answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 820 fakes pays 546 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. The harbor is the check that cannot be faked, the meadow is the price the attacker pays, and the thread is the record that outlives the epoch.
